question: Should Vault token-introspection failure remain advisory so ambiguous or denied lookup-self cases stay owner-scoped, while only unambiguous shared provider outages emit the aggregate diagnostic?
rationale: This is an auth-provider compatibility policy choice: it determines whether existing restricted Vault tokens are diagnosed as a shared provider outage or as independent reference failures.

options.title: Confirm advisory introspection
options.body: Keep the current final-head behavior, document the lookup-self capability expectation, and merge after real Gateway proof covers both outcomes.

options.title: Require stronger provider classification
options.body: Treat a defined class of lookup-self failures as provider-scoped and add explicit compatibility tests and upgrade documentation before merge.

recommendation.title: Confirm advisory introspection
recommendation.body: Keep the current final-head behavior, document the lookup-self capability expectation, and merge after real Gateway proof covers both outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current Vault classification implementation and the stated compatibility-contract revision.
